source_review.scope: All six POX rows and ten kinetic columns, table footnotes h-k, Supplementary Results printed page 4 and Methods printed pages 8-9, organism/assay identity, source bytes and user-facing claim wording. Parent separately inspected source image and rendered methods.

representation_review.scope: Distinct chemical substrates, covalent analogue model, assay-qualified parameters, unavailable values, quotient provenance, uncertainty and exact cross-context reuse; all cells and bindings independently checked.

adversarial_review.scope: Generic inactivity, authentic-pyruvate nonbinding, oxygen turnover, elementary-step/geometry causation, evidence duplication and incumbent value.
adversarial_review.decision: Accept the bounded evidence-semantics constraint and source-reported fitted wording; no design-performance or independent-validation claim.

adjudications.objection: The same n.a. token could imply zero activity or the same missingness cause across TKT and POX.
adjudications.evidence: POX Table 2b footnote k versus TKT Table 2a footnote e and exact /variants/1/stopped_flow/k_forward pointer in the hash-bound prior comparison.
adjudications.decision: Retain reported MAP nonbinding separately from TKT reporter absence. All unavailable parameters remain null; positive source-reported pyruvate rate parameters keep their own assay scopes.

adjudications.objection: MAP affinity could become pyruvate affinity or a noncovalent docking constant.
adjudications.evidence: Table footnote i and Methods printed page 8, equations 9-10: a covalent nonprocessed MAP-ThDP conjugate and two-state apparent model.
adjudications.decision: Keep analogue/chemical identity, k_on, k_off and K_D_app scoped to that model; no substitution for pyruvate K_M or K_0.5.

adjudications.objection: An apparent processing rate could be described as direct observation of an elementary catalytic step or oxygen turnover.
adjudications.evidence: Methods printed page 9 explicitly combines several microscopic steps under anaerobic FAD reporting; printed page 8 steady state uses DCPIP replacing oxygen.
adjudications.decision: Use positive source-reported fitted parameters; exclude elementary-step, oxygen-turnover, physiological-rate and geometric-causation claims.

adjudications.objection: Source method omissions and typographic inconsistencies could be silently repaired.
adjudications.evidence: Methods page 8 prints MAP path length 10 mM; page 9 does not state pH. Methods and Fig. 8 use different MAP spellings.
adjudications.decision: Keep normalized path length and unstated pH null, preserve the literal unit and both source names, and do not infer an external chemical identifier.

adjudications.objection: Source ratios could be recomputed as exact measurements, with wrong denominator units or invented precision.
adjudications.evidence: Table ratio units differ by assay; E60A source single-turnover efficiency is 12.5 while displayed 113/9.0 gives 12.5556.
adjudications.decision: Retain all 17 source quotient values, explicit formula/denominator/conversion provenance, null SD and non-independent identity; keep an arithmetic witness without source repair.

adjudications.objection: Triplicates, repeated Figure 8 experiments, HTML/JPEG and cross-context projections could duplicate evidence.
adjudications.evidence: One study, one table in two formats; table-level n=3 statement; Fig. 8 repeat statement; exact old TKT comparison binding.
adjudications.decision: Do not infer n=6, independent biological preparation count, new table rows from figures, or new observations from quoted metrics and reuse.

adjudications.objection: Another table curation might supply no reusable value or require case-specific machinery.
adjudications.evidence: Both comparisons accept the same traversal over assay_id-qualified parameter groups; four unavailable-assay variant contexts preserve their distinct causes beside separate steady-state assays.
adjudications.decision: Use additive data only. The value is preserving functional-label eligibility, not novel chemistry, faster curation or superiority to a competent source reading. No new runtime or validator is warranted.

source_access.limit: Retained local bytes only. Historical unmetered browser discovery remains unresolved; this operation creates no fresh allowance.

verification_scope: Exact-source computational reviews, source/body hash checks, complete table-cell comparison, 17 quotient arithmetic witnesses at displayed rounding, eight within-assay central-value ratios, exact reuse pointers and one generic traversal. Existing repository contracts/CI remain required and verify software/integrity, not physical truth.
publication_limits: Publisher source bodies remain locally retained and are not redistributed. Exact transcription review requires matching bodies; hashes and public locators alone do not reproduce the table.
